name: harlequin
description: Easy, fast, and beautiful database client for the terminal

repo.name: harlequin
repo.description: The SQL IDE for Your Terminal.

readme.summary: Exceptionally clear and comprehensive documentation with excellent installation guidance, multiple database examples, and appropriate references to full documentation.
readme.top_issue: Configuration section relies heavily on external links rather than showing inline examples of common config options

injection_risks.description: Potential SQL injection risk due to dynamic query construction in the `append_to_history` method
Use of `eval`-like functionality is not present, but string formatting is used to construct queries which may lead to potential injection risks if user input is not properly sanitized

critical_findings: Potential SQL injection risks due to lack of input validation and sanitization
Insufficient error handling and logging mechanisms in place
security.summary: The Harlequin application has some security concerns, including potential SQL injection risks and insufficient input validation, but overall it appears to be a well-structured and secure application.

common_complaints: UI crash on non-bbcode tooltip text
Missing configuration features (env variables, export directory)
praise_themes: High-quality project that replaced paid tools
Reliable daily driver for SQL TUI work
sentiment.summary: Healthy, actively maintained project with engaged users reporting specific bugs and thoughtful feature requests, showing strong community satisfaction despite some functional issues.

communication.summary: The maintainer provides helpful and clear responses, handles repeated questions patiently, and encourages new contributors, but sometimes lacks technical depth in explanations.

concerns: No commits in past 6 months despite last commit being recent (2026-02-11)
52 open issues with no recent activity or resolution
No closed issues in past 6 months
No merged PRs in past 6 months
No active contributors in past 6 months
Last commit date inconsistency suggests data may be referencing a different branch
positive_signals: Last commit timestamp is very recent (2026-02-11)
maintenance.summary: The package appears abandoned with zero activity across all maintenance indicators (commits, PRs, issues, releases, contributors) over the past 6 months, despite a recent commit timestamp that may indicate stale or incorrect data.

changelog.summary: The changelog is well-structured and easy to follow, but lacks explicit migration guides for breaking changes.

governance.summary: The Harlequin project lacks a clear succession plan and decision-making process, relying heavily on the primary maintainer.

project_metrics.description: The SQL IDE for Your Terminal.

analysis_summary.doc_summary: The Harlequin README provides clear and detailed installation instructions, but could benefit from more concise quick start examples and better organization of configuration and troubleshooting information.
concerns: Docs: Configuration options are scattered throughout the document and not clearly summarized in one place.
